recipe_inventory.scope: One source-defined gel precipitation/decomposition route; essential missing charge volumes and workup remain explicit.20nm is XRD/Scherrer, not a measured particle contour.
gaps: Complete supplied five-page main, Figure 1, Tables 1–5, equations 1–12 and all 12 numbered references. SI and cited full sources unreviewed.

The source gives precursor concentrations but not their volumes, mole ratio, hydroxide addition rate, gel aging, isolation/washing, decomposition atmosphere, heating ramp or yield. No quantities or cited-book procedures are supplied by inference.
Zinc nitrate hydration, reagent purities and the exact solution solvent are not named. Formula Zn(NO3)2 identifies the nominal solute; no hydrate formula is inferred.
The 20 nm Scherrer value belongs to the prepared nanocrystalline ZnO. No measured crystallographic polymorph, unit cell, particle morphology or atomic coordinates are supplied.
The one-year-later nanocr2 measurement has no storage environment or new post-storage size measurement. No fresh synthesis, retained 20 nm size, or growth time is inferred from that interval.

The empty platinum cell cleaning at 1550 K for 6 h precedes sample loading and is analytical apparatus conditioning, not ZnO synthesis. The later 450 K/4 h high-vacuum sample conditioning is characterization preparation.

source_notes.label: Synthesis versus measurement
source_notes.summary: The gel preparation/decomposition gives the source nanocrystalline ZnO. Empty-cell cleaning, high-vacuum conditioning and hot vaporization belong to analysis; they do not supply additional growth schedules.

source_notes.label: Aging interpretation
source_notes.summary: The authors interpret nanocr1 as metastable and nanocr2 as aged material with vaporization behavior closer to microcrystalline ZnO. No new particle size or storage atmosphere is reported.

source_notes.label: Formal ion ratios
source_notes.summary: The Zn+/O2+ signals cannot determine vapor molar composition because scattered oxygen gives uncontrolled background. The table ratio remains an instrumental observation.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, Oxygen background and Table 2

source_notes.label: Unresolved pressure scale
source_notes.summary: Table 3 coefficient rows are preserved without guessed powers of ten. The source pressure fits/plot and upper-limit table are available separately, without numerically repairing the table.
